loc-1765285769087-uch0a3ayy.name: Aquatic Reclamation Zone

dna.looks: Vast oceanic expanses dotted with the decaying remnants of human structures. The landscape is a blend of natural water bodies and man-made ruins, with signs of extensive environmental interaction.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by the blues and greens of the ocean, with natural sunlight creating bright, diffused illumination. Shadows are soft and muted, characteristic of daylight filtering through water or haze.
dna.atmosphere: A generally calm and humid atmosphere, with the pervasive scent of salt. Weather patterns are typical of coastal regions, with possibilities of gentle breezes and occasional mist.
dna.materials: A wide range of materials, from natural rock and coral to weathered composites and metals of abandoned structures. These materials show signs of extensive exposure to water and the elements.
dna.mood: A sense of quiet contemplation, the bittersweet beauty of nature's resilience, and the vastness of time. The mood is generally peaceful but carries an undertone of loss and abandonment.
dna.sounds: Oceanic ambient sounds, distant waves, wind, seabirds, natural water flow.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Encased in marine growth, barnacles, algae
dna.accent_features: Coastal flora reclaiming surfaces, underwater reefs
dna.secondary: Muted earth tones: rusty orange, off-white (approx. 35%)

loc-1765285769087-uch0a3ayy.description: A future where humanity's coastal settlements have been abandoned due to environmental shifts. The oceans have advanced, reclaiming cities and structures, fostering new, resilient ecosystems on the ruins of civilization.
loc-1765285769087-uch0a3ayy.searchDesc: A future world where oceans reclaim abandoned coastal cities, fostering new life on their ruins.

structure.spatialLayout: An open and expansive spatial layout, primarily defined by water and horizon lines. Structures create localized points of interest within the vastness.

07f95e76-beec-43b2-a22c-9d8f7ada6d7b.name: The Drowned Coast

dna.looks: A collection of decaying, modular structures partially or fully submerged in the ocean. Forms are weathered and rounded by water and time, with visible signs of structural compromise.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominant hues of muted blues and greens from the water, accented by the rust and faded whites of the structures. Light filters down through the water, creating dappled patterns and obscuring details in deeper areas.
dna.atmosphere: The air is heavy with moisture and carries the scent of salt and decay. Water currents are gentle around the submerged portions, with occasional surface chop from offshore breezes. The visibility is generally good in shallow areas.
dna.materials: Predominantly aged, rusted metals and composites, encrusted with barnacles, algae, and coral. Exposed surfaces are pitted and worn by wave action and saltwater corrosion.
dna.mood: A profound sense of melancholy and the weight of forgotten history. There's a peaceful stillness, punctuated only by the gentle sounds of the sea, evoking a quiet resignation to nature's power.
dna.sounds: Gentle lapping waves, distant seabirds, muffled underwater creaks and groans.
dna.accent_features: Patches of vibrant seaweed and coral
dna.secondary: Faded rusty orange and mottled white-grey (structures, approx. 35%)
dna.cultural_tone: abandoned futuristic dwellings, lost to the sea
dna.materials_base: weathered metals and composites, marine encrustation
dna.palette_bias: aquatic blues and greens, muted earth tones

07f95e76-beec-43b2-a22c-9d8f7ada6d7b.description: A desolate expanse of weathered coastal structures, now largely submerged and serving as artificial reefs. The remnants of human habitation are slowly being consumed by the encroaching ocean and its vibrant ecosystems.
07f95e76-beec-43b2-a22c-9d8f7ada6d7b.searchDesc: Submerged ruins of abandoned coastal dwellings, reclaimed by the ocean and marine life.

structure.spatialLayout: An expansive, horizontal landscape defined by the waterline and the seabed. Structures are scattered and semi-submerged, creating a varied underwater topography.

0c51cef4-9147-4adc-9c31-b137987d0e84.name: The Sunken Hab-Pod Cluster

dna.looks: Several interconnected, weathered modules forming a cluster. Cylindrical and spherical shapes dominate, with large circular openings. The scale is modest, suggesting individual or small-group dwellings.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Faded rusty orange and mottled white-grey colors are primary, accented by vibrant green from moss and vegetation. The lighting is soft, diffused daylight, creating no harsh shadows.
dna.atmosphere: The air is calm and likely humid, with a slight salt tang. The water is placid and clear, allowing visibility of the seafloor. The sky is hazy and bright, suggesting a warm, possibly tropical climate with diffused sunlight.
dna.materials: The primary materials appear to be aged composite or metal, now heavily weathered and stained. Moss and sparse vegetation indicate a long period of abandonment and exposure to the elements.
dna.mood: The mood is one of quiet desolation and peaceful natural reclamation. There is a sense of lingering mystery and the passage of time, evoking a feeling of solitude.
dna.sounds: Gentle lapping water, distant seabirds, rustling vegetation, muffled underwater sounds
dna.secondary_surfaces: sandy seafloor, clear water, hazy sky
dna.accent_features: reddish interior, rusted metal ladder, patches of green seaweed/coral
dna.accent: vibrant green (moss/vegetation, approx. 15%), deep reddish-brown (interior, approx. 5%)
dna.architectural_tone: weathered modular pods with organic integration
dna.cultural_tone: abandoned futuristic dwelling, reclaimed by nature
dna.palette_bias: muted earth tones with aquatic blues and greens

0c51cef4-9147-4adc-9c31-b137987d0e84.description: An exterior scene featuring an abandoned, pod-like dwelling, partially submerged in calm, clear turquoise ocean water. The structure is composed of several interconnected, weathered cylindrical and spherical modules, primarily in faded rusty orange and mottled white-grey colors, with green moss and sparse vegetation growing across its surfaces. Large circular openings serve as windows and entrances, and one lower pod has an open section revealing a reddish interior and a rusted metal ladder extending into the water.
0c51cef4-9147-4adc-9c31-b137987d0e84.searchDesc: Submerged futuristic hab-pods in clear turquoise water, overgrown with moss and vegetation.

structure.spatialLayout: The pods are clustered together, with some modules partially submerged, creating an organic spread rather than a rigid structure. The space extends vertically into the water and horizontally across the cluster.

navigableElements.description: An open section in a lower pod revealing a reddish interior and a rusted metal ladder leading into the water.
Large circular openings serve as entrances to the pods.

dominantElements: Faded rusty orange and mottled white-grey colors
